# DX-91: Generated File Contract

**Status:** Implementation-facing contract  
**Date:** 2026-03-12  
**Derived from:** DX-91-migration-semantics.md (final)  

---

## 1. Purpose

This document defines the **canonical contract** for all files generated by `invar init` v2. It translates DX-91 finalized semantics into explicit requirements for:

1. **Runtime/template work** — What the init command must generate
2. **Repository documentation** — What INVAR.md/CLAUDE.md in the repo must contain
3. **Work split** — Which proposal sections are source-of-truth for each deliverable

---

## 2. Generated Files Contract

### 2.1 CLAUDE.md (Injected Section)

**Source of truth:** `docs/proposals/DX-91-claude-md-draft.md` section "Injected Content (~50 lines)"

**Contract:**

| Attribute | Requirement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Markers** | Single pair: `<!--invar:begin-->` / `<!--invar:end-->` |
| **Lines** | ~50 lines (±10 lines acceptable) |
| **Idempotent** | Re-running init replaces content between markers exactly |
| **User content** | Content outside markers preserved verbatim |
| **Target file** | `CLAUDE.md` by default; `--file` supports alternatives |

**Required Content Sections:**

```markdown
<!--invar:begin-->
## Invar

[CRITICAL one-liner about contracts first]

### Architecture
[Zone table: Core vs Shell with paths and rules]

### Verification
[invar guard instruction]

### Tools
[Tool table: guard, sig, map, refs]

### Contract Traps
[Lambda @pre @post syntax examples]

### Escape Hatches
[@invar:allow example]

[Reference to INVAR.md for full spec]
<!--invar:end-->
```

**Explicitly Removed from v1:**
- ❌ `<!--invar:critical-->` / `<!--invar:managed-->` / `<!--invar:project-->` / `<!--invar:user-->` markers
- ❌ Check-In/Final protocol ceremony
- ❌ USBV phase headers
- ❌ Task completion checklists
- ❌ Skills/hooks references
- ❌ TypeScript variants
- ❌ `.invar/examples/` references

---

### 2.2 INVAR.md (Fully Managed)

**Source of truth:** `docs/proposals/DX-91-invar-md-draft.md` (entire document)

**Contract:**

| Attribute | Requirement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Markers** | NONE — entire file is overwritten on init |
| **Lines** | ~70-120 lines (target: compact agent spec) |
| **Idempotent** | Full overwrite; content identical for same version |
| **User edits** | NOT supported; add custom rules to CLAUDE.md user section |
| **Location** | Top-level `INVAR.md` |

**Required Sections (stable anchors for guard diagnostics):**

1. **Before Writing Code** — Contracts first, Core vs Shell decision
2. **Core vs Shell** — Decision rule and zone table
3. **Contract Syntax Traps** — @pre lambda params, @post(result) scope
4. **Canonical Core Example** — Python @pre/@post + doctest
5. **Canonical Shell Example** — Python Result[T, E]
6. **Escape Hatches** — @invar:allow syntax
7. **Minimal Configuration** — pyproject.toml snippet
8. **Common Guard Repairs** — Error-to-fix table with INVAR.md section links

**Explicitly Removed from v1:**
- ❌ References to `.invar/examples/`
- ❌ Skills/hooks documentation
- ❌ TypeScript variants
- ❌ Multi-language support sections
- ❌ Expanded prose (keep concise, reference CLAUDE.md for tools)

---

### 2.3 .pre-commit-config.yaml

**Source of truth:** `DX-91-migration-semantics.md` section 3.2

**Contract:**

| Attribute | Requirement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Content** | Single hook: `invar guard` |
| **Lines** | ~8 lines |
| **Generated** | Yes, if not exists |
| **Managed** | No (user can customize) |

## 4. Marker System Contract

### 4.1 v2 Single-Marker System

```markdown
<!--invar:begin-->
... managed content ...
<!--invar:end-->
```

**Behavior:**
- If markers exist → replace content between them
- If markers missing → append section with markers
- User content outside markers → never touched

### 4.2 v1 to v2 Migration Mapping

| v1 Marker | v2 Handling |
|-----------|-------------|
| `<!--invar:critical-->` | Content merged into single v2 block OR preserved outside markers |
| `<!--invar:managed-->` | Replaced by `<!--invar:begin/end-->` |
| `<!--invar:project-->` | Content moved to user region (outside markers) OR `.invar/project-additions.md` |
| `<!--invar:user-->` | Preserved verbatim outside markers |

---

## 5. Intentionally Deferred

The following are **explicitly NOT in scope** for runtime rewrite to prevent scope creep:

| Deferred Item | Rationale | Future Work |
|---------------|-----------|-------------|
| Wording cleanup in guard error messages | Can be done post-DX-91 | DX-92 ( Guard DX improvements) |
| Additional escape hatch types | Only `dead_export` needed for MVP | Future proposal |
| Multi-language INVAR.md | Python-only per simplified boundary | Separate proposal if needed |
| `.invar/context.md` generation | No longer generated; user creates if needed | Document only |
| Migration rollback command | Out of scope; manual backup sufficient | Not planned |

## 7. No Unresolved Ambiguity Checklist

| Question | Resolution | Location |
|----------|------------|----------|
| Minimum CLAUDE.md injected content? | ~50 lines, 6 sections | §2.1, DX-91-claude-md-draft.md |
| Marker format? | `<!--invar:begin-->` / `<!--invar:end-->` | §2.1, DX-91-migration-semantics.md §3.3 |
| File split (runtime vs repo)? | Runtime=src/invar/templates/, Repo=docs/ | §3 |
| INVAR.md length target? | ~70-120 lines | §2.2, DX-91-invar-md-draft.md |
| What happens to v1 markers? | Migrated to single v2 block | §4.2 |
| What stays in CLAUDE.md user section? | Everything outside markers | §2.1 |
| Is INVAR.md user-editable? | NO — fully managed | §2.2 |
| Dev sync scope after DX-91? | CLAUDE.md + INVAR.md only | §3.1, DX-91-migration-semantics.md §5 |
